extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / editors (especially new users attempting to create an article)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for contributors attempting to create or locate a Wikipedia article for a television show title; covers account requirements, searching for existing pages, redirects, and troubleshooting deleted or not-yet-visible pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New article creation is restricted: users must have an account and meet the autoconfirmed status before creating pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or submit a draft / request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create the page directly, use the article wizard to prepare a draft for review or follow the 'request a new article' process as alternatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "HBO Half-Hour Comedy Hour" in existing articles. Look for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, thoroughly search Wikipedia for similarly titled pages or variant spellings to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check what links here (find pages linking to the title)
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investigate incoming links to determine whether a topic is covered under a different page or redirect target.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delay in visibility for recently created pages — wait or purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you suspect the page was just created but isn't shown, allow time for database updates or use 'purge' to refresh the page view.

rubrics_metrics.name: Case sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check different capitalizations and, if appropriate, create a redirect from the variant title to the canonical page to aid discoverability.

rubrics_metrics.name: If page deleted, consult the deletion log / 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a page is missing because it was deleted, review the deletion log and relevant help pages to understand the reason and whether recreation is appropriate.
